faqs.question: How long does an Odoo migration take?
faqs.answer: Depending on data volume and complexity, migrations typically take 4–12 weeks from kickoff to go-live.

faqs.answer: Yes, we migrate from SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, QuickBooks, Tally, and most other ERP/accounting platforms.

faqs.question: Which processes are best suited for RPA?
faqs.answer: High-volume, rule-based, repetitive processes with structured data are ideal — such as invoice processing, data entry, report generation, and system reconciliation.
